articles.title: Polymarket brings ultra-short crypto prediction markets to U.S. platform
articles.snippet: Polymarket’s new Up/Down crypto contracts come as the CFTC renews scrutiny of the prediction market’s compliance with its 2022 U.S. onboarding terms.

articles.title: Why Switzerland’s first genuine spot bitcoin ETF could soon attract overseas banks and brokers
articles.snippet: SIX Swiss Exchange confirms international access, while FINMA explains why it approved the fund and whether ether and solana ETFs could follow.

articles.title: A new framework for tokenized asset tracking
articles.snippet: None of the numbers most commonly used to assess tokenized assets answer the question a chief investment officer would ask about those assets on her own balance sheet: what is it doing for me?

articles.title: Kalshi raises $1B at $40B valuation as non-sports revenue run rate tops $1B
articles.snippet: The funding round comes as Kalshi expands its partnerships with the NBA and S&P Dow Jones Indices while facing legal challenges over its sports contracts.

articles.title: Chainalysis traces North Korean crypto cash-outs through Garantex
articles.snippet: The analysis followed US sanctions against 10 people and one entity accused of helping North Korean IT worker schemes fund weapons programs.
